tokentrim pro monday digest

Tokentrim Pro includes a Monday Digest that emails you a brief summary of Claude Code usage each week. It shows token totals, cost reduction and any budget alerts so you can stay aware of limits.

How the Monday Digest works

  1. Install Tokentrim Pro (lifetime or monthly).
  2. Activate the Pro features, including the hosted dashboard.
  3. Set a weekly budget and the 80 % alert threshold.
  4. Every Monday you receive an email with usage numbers, cost‑reduction range (55‑70 %) and any budget warnings.

What you get

  • Hosted dashboard that you can open on any device.
  • Weekly Monday Digest email with token usage and budget alerts.
  • Free features such as daily budget guard and cold‑cache alert.
  • Pro pricing: $49 one‑time lifetime (first 500 buyers) or $9 per month.
  • Support for up to 3 machines.

FAQ

Does the digest cost extra beyond the Pro price? No. The Monday Digest is included in the Pro subscription, whether you choose the $49 lifetime fee or the $9 monthly plan.

Do I need the hosted dashboard to receive the digest? The digest is part of the Pro package; enabling Pro features provides the data needed for the email, but no additional steps are required beyond the Pro activation.

Will my data leave my machine? By default nothing leaves your machine. The hosted dashboard stores only the information needed for the digest; all other hooks run locally.
